musicpiano.title: Tuning a piano
musicpiano.author: Pierre SIBANARCO
musicpiano.modifications: One complete isolated strike/shake excerpt; original pitch, gentle amplitude normalization, short edge fades.
musicpiano.runtimeNotes: Four beats resample the original recorded A as A, B, C-sharp, B. Stored source pitch is retained. Pitch-preserving time stretch is disabled; light/heavy changes only volume.
